393cda5c151d.description_html:
Hermeus is a venture-backed defense aviation company reclaiming the lost art of rapid iterative prototyping to build the fastest aircraft in the world today. By prioritizing relentless hardware iteration, we deliver high-speed systems at the pace of the modern battlefield. We work with the Department of War to provide the high-speed capabilities our nation and its allies need to maintain a durable, asymmetric advantage. By prioritizing relentless hardware iteration, we deliver high-speed systems at the pace of the modern battlefield. We work with the Department of War to provide the high-speed capabilities our nation and its allies need to maintain a durable, asymmetric advantage.

About The Role: 

As a Test and Operations Engineering Intern at Hermeus, you will support the development, integration, and testing of advanced aircraft systems in a hands-on environment. You will work alongside engineers, technicians, and cross-functional teams to assist with hardware integration, system checkout, development testing, and test readiness activities.

This role is ideal for someone interested in engineering operations, test execution, and rapid hardware development. You will help troubleshoot issues, improve procedures, and support the tools and workflows that make vehicle testing safer, faster, and more repeatable.

  Spring: Around 16 weeks (January - April) Summer: Around 12 weeks (May - August)

Responsibilities:

Work alongside experienced engineers to support the planning, execution, and analysis of flight tests, gaining direct exposure to real-world aerospace challenges. Develop test plans, procedures, checklists, and flight test cards. Monitor telemetry during testing and assist with real-time troubleshooting and decision-making. Review test data, identify issues, and help develop engineering conclusions and next steps. Design, build, and troubleshoot test hardware, tooling, GSE, wiring, and instrumentation. Support integration across mechanical, electrical, fluid, software, and vehicle systems. Develop scripts and automation tools to improve test efficiency and repeatability. Collaborate with engineers, technicians, and pilots to prepare systems for testing. Travel as needed to support vehicle integration and test operations.

Requirements:

Must be currently enrolled in a STEM program at an accredited college or university (undergraduate student in your third or fourth year of study, or enrolled in a Master's or Ph.D. program). Hands-on experience designing, building, and testing vehicles through internships, studies or projects. Experience with engineering tools such as CAD, C++, Python, or similar technical software. Strong engineering fundamentals and interest in test and operational environments. Strong interest in flight testing. Strong understanding of engineering first principles. Demonstrated ability to work within cross-functional teams. Enthusiasm for aviation and Hermeus's mission. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. GPA of 3.0 or above.

The hourly rate listed for this internship is intended as a general guideline. Final compensation will be determined based on degree level.

Benefits:

  • Time Off: Interns are eligible for 5 days of sick leave and unpaid time off.
  • Office Perks: Weekly paid office lunches and fully stocked breakrooms.
  U.S. EXPORT CONTROL COMPLIANCE STATUS  The person hired will have access to information and items subject to U.S. export controls, and therefore, must either be a “U.S. person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. § 120.62 or otherwise eligible for deemed export licensing. US persons include U.S. citizens, U.S. nationals, lawful permanent residents (green card holders), and asylees and refugees with such status granted, not pending.    EQUAL OPPORTUNITY Hermeus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. 39a4f132d5b0.description_html:
Software Engineering Intern (Winter/Spring/Summer 2026) — Agentic AI Startup

Location: San Francisco, CA (Hybrid or Remote-First)
Type: Full-Time Internship (10–14 weeks, depending on academic calendar)
Compensation: Competitive stipend

About Us

We are an early-stage AI startup building the first AI-native productivity assistant that seamlessly integrates into your digital life to handle email, calendars, contacts, and tasks and make sure you never drop the ball. Backed by leading venture capital firms including Village Global, Neo, SV Angel, and researchers and executives from Anthropic, Microsoft, Cognition, Quora, Atlassian, and Waymo, we’re assembling a world-class founding team passionate about building scalable, human-aligned AI systems that transform how life gets done.

Our founding team includes repeat entrepreneurs, AI researchers, and early engineers from companies such as Meta, Palantir, Dropbox, and Databricks. Collectively, we’ve built products used by millions, led teams at unicorn-stage AI companies, raised over $100 million in venture capital, and achieved exits to Fortune 500 firms. Together, we bring deep expertise across AI systems design, large-scale engineering, and growth at the intersection of technology and human productivity.

The Role

As a Software Engineering Intern, you’ll work closely with our founding team to help design, prototype, and scale components of our agentic AI assistant.

This is a hands-on opportunity to do work at the intersection of systems design thinking with AI engineering fundamentals, contributing directly to the architecture and functionality of real, production-bound technology.

You’ll have mentorship from experienced engineers and founders building next-generation AI systems and gain valuable exposure to startup operations, while maintaining meaningful ownership over your projects and deliverables.

What You’ll Do

  • Collaborate with engineers to design and implement core infrastructure and backend components.

  • Develop core features across the AI stack — including orchestration logic, API integrations, and LLM-based workflows.

  • Build diagnostic tools, write test cases, and implement monitoring systems for reliability and consistency.

  • Contribute to the design and improvement of our agent reasoning and execution pipelines.

  • Participate in product and architecture discussions with the founding team.

  • Document bugs, issues, and edge cases; help refine and stabilize our platform for launch-readiness.

Who You Are

  • Currently pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, AI, or related field (or equivalent experience).

  • Strong foundation in software engineering and systems design thinking — you enjoy reasoning about architecture, scalability, and tradeoffs.

  • Experience with Python, JavaScript, or Go; familiarity with AI frameworks (e.g. LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar) is a plus.

  • Interest or prior experience in agent development, LLM APIs, or applied AI engineering.

  • Excited by early-stage environments and fast-paced, iterative work.

  • Available full-time for one academic quarter or semester in Winter/Spring/Summer 2026.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building prototypes or projects that integrate AI models or autonomous agents.

  • Exposure to distributed systems, vector databases, or API orchestration.

  • Previous internship or research experience in applied AI or software engineering.

  • Contributions to open-source or personal AI/automation projects.

What You’ll Gain

  • Direct mentorship from experienced AI and systems engineers.

  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge agentic AI technology in a startup environment.

  • End-to-end ownership of meaningful projects that may evolve into core product features.

  • Exposure to startup operations, product iteration, and the engineering culture of an early-stage team.

39ce88f0efa5.title: Software Engineering Intern
39ce88f0efa5.description_html:
We are looking for interns for Fall or Winter (September 2026 - December 2026) and (January 2027 - April 2027). We can also accommodate different periods of time and sponsor Visa's if needed.

Feel free to apply if you're interested in UI/UX or are looking for a ML research intern role as well!

About Phoebe

Phoebe is modernizing America's home healthcare infrastructure. This is the coordination layer for one of the largest labor markets in the country.

We're looking for hungry, high-throughput generalist engineers as we scale into the multi-millions over the next 6 months.


About You

We're looking for hungry, high-throughput generalist engineers as we scale into the multi-millions over the next 6 months. You might want to start your own company one day, but aren’t sure what to build yet. You might have spent time at a larger unicorn and want to join a fast growing startup with PMF.

You will:

  • Get a clear view into engineering, product, go-to-market, and the iterative loop that connects all 3

  • Learn the Vertical AI playbook

    • how to embed into an industry, learn the domain, and build LLM-driven workflows to automate it.

    • How to generate demand with modern GTM techniques across B2B and B2C


What You'll Build

  • Voice and SMS agents that automate the 24/7 shift lifecycle (confirmations, clock-ins, notes, last-minute coverage)

  • LLM orchestration across prompt engineering, tool use, context management, and evals that keep agents reliable as we scale

  • Internal ops tooling so our team can monitor agent performance, handle edge cases, and onboard new customers fast

  • Reliability and observability improvements across our voice and messaging infrastructure

  • Full-stack features from data model to API to UI, shipped to real customers within days

 

Your First 90 Days

  • Month 1: Ship something real. You'll pair-program with the team immediately and ship features within your first week. By the end of month one, you'll own a complete feature from design to production.

  • Month 2: Go deep on the orchestration layer. You'll improve reliability and observability across our voice and messaging stack, and contribute to how we evaluate agent quality at scale.

  • Month 3: Take ownership. You'll scope and lead a feature area yourself, such as a new EHR integration, an improvement to the talent agent product, or better tooling for our ops team.

 

Our Tech

  • React / TypeScript / Vite on the frontend

  • FastAPI / Python on the backend

  • Postgres (RDS)

  • Twilio for voice and SMS

  • LLMs throughout

  • AWS

  • Linear, Notion

 

You're a Good Fit If

  • You're a strong generalist who can work across the stack

  • You stay on the cutting edge of AI dev workflows and love using coding agents to automate engineering, observability, and the entire development workflow.

  • You ship fast and iterate based on real usage

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and figuring things out as you go

  • You've worked with LLMs in production (or are eager to)

  • You want to be early at a company that's growing very quickly


What We Offer

  • Interesting, high-leverage work at a company growing very fast

  • Above market salary

  • Small team where your work ships to customers immediately

  • In-person in NYC - we work in the same room

  • Multiple second-time founders to learn from - Justin (CEO) sold Bayes (YC S19) to Airtable. Dave built and sold Kamana, an app for travel nurses.

39e6fce961cc.title: Robotics & Embedded Systems Intern
39e6fce961cc.description_html:
About Odys

At Odys, we’re mobilizing power, with Hybrid Power Systems developed for aerospace and in-demand everywhere. It’s the kind of mission diversity that demands a fresh way of thinking.

We began with an early bet on hybrid, when the mobility industry was focused on batteries. We designed, tested, and validated our first 1 MW high-speed generator in 12 months. And then we pushed further, developing systems with greater power density in less time. Today, our Hybrid Power Systems offer outputs ranging from 20 kW to 4 MW, with applications in the air or on the ground.

One of those applications is Laila, an unmanned drone designed for critical logistics and defense missions. With its 100 kW-class onboard Hybrid Power System, Laila can support medical cold-chain transport or serve as an aerial platform for counter-UAS measures.

The market interest has been overwhelming: Over 30 inbound requests from leading US and global manufacturers, and 14+ DoD contracts.

Our team comes from deep tech and aerospace, with backgrounds spanning drone and aircraft development, high-volume production, and electrified mobility.

We operate with urgency and ownership at every level. We validated high-speed generator technology faster than our peers, not because we skipped steps, but because we've been doing this long enough to know which ones matter most.

Creating the future of power, in the air and on the ground, is a challenge we’ve been training our entire lives for. If that sounds like you, this is the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

 

About the Role

  • We are looking for a motivated intern to assist our robotics team in building and integrating unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) platforms used for autonomous testing and sensor development.

  • This role is ideal for students interested in robotics, drones, mechatronics, and embedded systems, who enjoy hands-on work with hardware and system integration.

  • The intern will support the development team by assembling UAV platforms, integrating sensors and communication devices, and assisting with system-level bench and flight testing.

Responsibilities

  • Assist in assembling and maintaining UAV platforms used for research and development

  • Support integration of sensors, cameras, radios, and communication modules

  • Perform wiring, soldering, and hardware setup for onboard electronics

  • Help verify hardware functionality (power, communication, sensor outputs)

  • Assist with bench testing and flight testing preparation

  • Support integration of hardware with onboard compute systems

  • Help document wiring diagrams, system configurations, and integration procedures

  • Assist with scripting or software tasks when required (e.g., device testing, logging)

  • Travel to support field flight testing operations (~20% of the time)

Required Qualifications

  • Pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related field

  • Strong interest in robotics systems and UAVs

  • Basic knowledge of electronics and electrical systems

  • Experience with wiring, connectors, or soldering

  • Familiarity with Linux and basic programming (Python or C++)

  • Experience with ROS2

  • Ability to work hands-on with hardware and troubleshoot issues

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with drones or robotics platforms

  • Familiarity with embedded systems or microcontrollers

  • Experience with communication protocols (UART, SPI, CAN, I2C)

  • Experience with PX4 autopilot

  • Experience integrating sensors or cameras

What You'll Gain

  • Hands-on experience working with real UAV platforms

  • Exposure to sensor integration and autonomous system development

  • Opportunity to work alongside engineers developing next-generation autonomous vehicles

  • Experience with hardware-software integration in robotics systems
